title: White Chocolate Chunk Brownies
changes_from_base: Dark chocolate batter with chunks of white chocolate through it and on top.
summary: Dark chocolate brownies with chunks of white chocolate folded through and pressed on top.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 100 g for the batter, 30 g for the top

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin. Whisk together the flour, salt and baking powder.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Melt the butter and dark chocolate gently, then take off the heat and whisk in both sugars and the vanilla.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Once the mixture is just warm, whisk in the eggs one at a time until thick and shiny.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold in the flour mixture, then 100 g of the white chocolate chunks. Spread in the tin and press the rest of the chunks into the surface.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 24-28 min, until the top is set and a skewer comes out with moist crumbs; avoid the white chocolate pockets when testing.

tips: Chop a good white chocolate bar for bigger, creamier pockets.
Let the chocolate mixture cool slightly before adding the eggs.
Wait until fully cool before cutting.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
